name: plugin-value-lab
description: Determine whether a plugin improves a specific task through paired comparisons, frozen plans, and recomputable results.

interface.shortDescription: Does this plugin improve this task? Pair, freeze, recompute.
interface.longDescription: Determine whether a plugin improves a specific task through paired comparisons, frozen plans, and recomputable results. Compare with-plugin and no-plugin records under matched conditions. Keep failures, uncertainty and missing evidence visible; scope conclusions to the tested task.
defaultPrompt: 用配对、冻结、可复算的评估，判断这个插件对我的具体任务有没有增益。
